title: Chapter 370 Terrifying Enemies
content:
Chapter 370 Terrifying Enemies

"This, Brother An, you know that Master Venerable has recreated me, I,"

Time and Space Win's face was tangled and hesitant.

But An Xing kept shaking his head.

"Brother Ying, call you "Brother". It's just because you are older than me and have some relationship with my city lord. But now, I believe you won't be confused about the situation in my wasteland city?"

Nowadays, the so-called order force is just an empty name.

The deserted city is the real leader.

Including Venerable Wuji, no one is not following the leader of the deserted city.

All of this is because of the lord of the deserted city, the omnipotent man.

The entire wasteland city is worthy of the man An Xing calls you, and you can count it with one hand.

An Xing almost put it outside, and you didn’t have the qualifications to carry my shoes to me.

As the master of the entire Time and Space Palace Hall, how could he not hear An Xing’s implied meaning after living for so long? For a moment, he also looked a little embarrassed.

But he couldn't refute it.

Only now did he realize how ungrateful he was.

There are so many people who want to join the deserted city. If you line up, you will probably be able to reach the end of the world.

It is no exaggeration to say that even if Venerable Wuji comes, he may nodify directly.

Yes, Lord Venerable!

Time and Space Ying's eyes flowed, he looked at An Xing, and asked, "Brother An, why don't you ask us Lord Venerable?"

"If Lord Venerable can join the Huangcheng, let alone me, even the entire order force will be part of the Huangcheng."

Hearing the words of Time and Space Win, An Xing smiled slightly, "Brother Win, you made one mistake."

"What?"

Time and Space Ying was slightly stunned and couldn't react.

I heard An Xing continue, "My Huangcheng has no plans to accept new things at the moment. I invite you to join the army, but it's just my personal intention."

Personal meaning.

Time and Star Win looked at An Xing with serious expression in front of him, and for a moment, he was speechless.

He couldn't understand what he could do, and would let this core figure in the senior management of Huangcheng come in person and invite him more than once.

"Can I know why?"

An Xing still had that smile, but he didn't mean to speak.

Everything is just about time and space to win.

For a moment, Shi Space Win fell into deep thought again.

Now, he really needs to think about it.

And An Xing did this naturally not without reason.

He knew why Shishiying came to the deserted city, and also knew the story between him and Lu Daosheng.

As an elder in the deserted city, An Xing knew very well that the Time and Space Palace had helped Lu Daosheng along the way.

Although not proactive.

But that's enough.

An Xing believes that as the master of the Time and Space Palace, Shi Space Win, has this opportunity to join the wasteland city.

Of course, at the end, I still have to report to the city lord in person.

At this time, time and space win finally ended.

He stood up suddenly, his eyes full of determination.

At this moment, he thought of the first time he met the Master Wuji.

"I won in the next time and space, and I have met Lord Venerable!"

At that time, time and space won, and his face was still a little tender. He knelt on one knee in the Yuanji Temple, with an excited expression.

Through continuous efforts, he finally met the strongest man at that time, his dream idol.

Yes, there are countless practitioners in the world, among which there are countless people who take Yuanji as their idol, whether it is Yan Lingyun or Shishi Win.

Venerable Yuanji still looked the same old look, but his eyes were full of energy.

He looked at the time and space below with a thumbs-up look in his eyes.

"Yes, I've gotten this far in such a short time."

Hearing the recognition of Yuanji Master for himself, fireworks ignited in his heart instantly, making a thump.

He raised his head, his eyes frenzy.

"Sir, this is thanks to your cultivation!"

Although he was extremely talented back then, it was so difficult to get to this point in the face of countless evil worlds.

But later, he ushered in a turning point in his first life.

By accident, he obtained a heritage.

The inheritance of the Yuanji Venerable.

The mystery of the Way of Time and Space was absorbed by the time and space win at that time and was perfectly in line with him.

From that moment on, he was completely impressed by Venerable Yuanji.

Now he has succeeded.

He successfully stood in front of Lord Venerable.

Buzz —

A dazzling white light flashed by, and then a fuzzy and orderly dark blue energy ball appeared in the palm of Venerable Wuji.

It kept squirming, as if there was life.

In an instant, the time and space below were like a feeling of feeling. Looking at the ball of energy, the desire in my eyes flashed.

"Time and space win, there is something, I don't know if you want it,"

"I do!"

Before Venerable Yuanji finished speaking, the time and space below were roaring impatiently.

Upon hearing this, Venerable Yuanji was slightly stunned, and the smile on his face became even stronger.

"That's great."

"I hope you can carry it forward."

Since then, one of the forces of order, the Palace of Time and Space, was founded, and quickly spread across countless known worlds with a wave of waves, becoming one of the top forces among the forces of order.

Retract your thoughts.

Time and Space Win stood in the pavilion, looking at An Xing standing in front of him.

At this moment, An Xing knew that time and space win had an answer.

"I do."

Time and Space Winning spoke calmly.

It was just like he promised the Master Yuanji to be, but this time, he was very calm.

"Welcome to join the deserted city."

An Xing smiled and extended his hand to Time and Space Win.

Shikongying breathed a sigh of relief, feeling unspeakable.

He held An Xing's hand tightly and shook it hard a few times.

"From the future, I will take care of you."

Rumble!

At this moment, a huge vibration suddenly came from outside the deserted city.

The shock was so strong that the entire deserted city was shaking.

In an instant, a huge sense of crisis hit An Xing's whole body.

laugh!

The space cracked, and An Xing disappeared in an instant.

At the same time, a huge alarm sounded throughout the deserted city, and countless people woke up one after another, looking horrified.

Is this an enemy attack? !

How is it possible that in this world, there are still people who dare to take action against Huangcheng and live impatiently?

No, the more this happens, the more terrifying it becomes.

How terrifying the strength of the opponent's opponent's courage to attack Huangcheng.

It's terrible to think about it carefully.

Everyone did not dare to hesitate and ran to the street one after another.

For a moment, the deserted city that had been silent for a long time became lively again.

But the atmosphere among the crowd was extremely depressing.

Outside the deserted city.

At this time, a stunning and talented woman was in the void, looking into the distance, her eyes flowing, not knowing what she was thinking.

The space cracked, and An Xing walked out of the space crack, and his face turned dark.

Immediately afterwards, Awei, Gu Chen, Huang Shou, Yun Qi and others appeared one after another.
